annotation.evidence_span: If the endpoint can no longer process the indicated connection IDs, it MAY close the connection.
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint can close the connection immediately upon being unable to process the connection IDs.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint is expected to attempt to resolve the issue preventing processing before closing the connection, but MAY close if resolution fails.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' combined with the lack of any attempt-to-resolve requirement creates ambiguity. An implementation could immediately close the connection upon encountering an issue, or it could attempt to recover before resorting to closure.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the endpoint is expected to attempt to resolve the inability to process the connection IDs before closing the connection. This missing constraint affects implementation behavior.
